data.change_summary: Connected photosynthesis and respiration to DIC/CO2 by setting stoichiometrically consistent non-zero defaults (respiration_dic = 0.01875, photosynthesis_dic = 0.075 mg C/g/h, derived from O2 rates × 12/32 = 0.375). The DIC pathway was already wired in chemistry.rs; the only code changes needed were (1) updating ProcessParams::default() in process.rs and default.toml from zero/arbitrary to stoichiometric values, and (2) zeroing DIC rates in closed-system conservation tests that cannot account for the open-system DIC shortcuts. Added 8 new tests in photosynthesis_dic.rs covering DIC consumption/production, day-night pH swing, biomass-scaling, stoichiometric consistency, and a 168-hour medium_planted integration test.
outstanding_risks: Daily plant/algae growth fires at midnight as a single large DIC draw, which can be 5-8× larger than the cumulative hourly photosynthesis DIC removal. This means endpoint light/dark pH comparisons across daily boundaries can show inverted patterns. The integration test was redesigned to check within-light-period trends instead of cross-boundary comparisons. A future bead could spread daily growth DIC consumption across daylight hours for more realistic diurnal coupling.
Pre-existing save_load_with_active_cycle_state test failure (ChaCha8Rng index state not preserved through serialization roundtrip) is unrelated to this change but warrants separate investigation.

Atmospheric CO2 gas exchange (K_LA) rapidly strips dissolved CO2, driving pH toward the 8.5 storage ceiling in scenarios with non-zero K_LA. The unit tests zero K_LA to isolate the DIC signal. Real scenarios with gas exchange will show a dampened diurnal pH pattern with pH biased toward alkaline.

steps.description: Explored codebase to confirm DIC pathway was already wired in chemistry.rs (hourly respiration/photosynthesis DIC fluxes at lines 559-571), plant_growth.rs (daily DIC consumption), and algae_growth.rs (daily DIC consumption). Identified that the only gap was zero defaults.

Updated ProcessParams::default() in crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs: respiration_dic_rate_mg_c_per_g_per_hour from 0.0 to 0.01875, photosynthesis_dic_rate_mg_c_per_g_per_hour from 0.0 to 0.075. Added comments explaining stoichiometric derivation (background_bod × 12/32 and plant_photosynthesis_o2 × 12/32).
Updated crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml: changed respiration_dic from 0.08 to 0.01875 and photosynthesis_dic from 0.12 to 0.075, with stoichiometric derivation comments.

Fixed closed-system carbon conservation tests that broke from non-zero DIC defaults. Added DIC rate zeroing to close_budget_gas_exchange() in budget_tracking.rs and budget_helpers.rs, to microfauna_test_state() in microfauna_routing.rs, and inline in shrimp_reproduction_budget_state and high_mortality_shrimp_state in budget_tracking.rs.

Created crates/tank_core/tests/photosynthesis_dic.rs with 7 unit tests: test_photosynthesis_consumes_dic, test_respiration_produces_dic, test_day_night_ph_swing (48h with 12h/12h photoperiod, asserts swing >= 0.1), test_heavy_plant_load_larger_ph_swing (2× biomass → larger swing), test_no_plants_minimal_ph_swing, test_photosynthesis_o2_dic_stoichiometry (within 5%), test_respiration_o2_dic_stoichiometry (within 5%).

Created integration test test_planted_tank_day_night_cycle: runs medium_planted scenario for 168 hours, verifies pH within storage bounds [5.5, 8.5], DIC varies over the simulation, within-light-period pH does not significantly decline, and plants survive with reasonable health.
Ran full test suite. All 300+ tests pass except pre-existing save_load_with_active_cycle_state failure (confirmed failing on master before this change). Clippy clean, fmt clean.

validation_evidence: cargo test --test photosynthesis_dic: 8/8 tests pass (photosynthesis_consumes_dic, respiration_produces_dic, day_night_ph_swing, heavy_plant_load_larger_ph_swing, no_plants_minimal_ph_swing, photosynthesis_o2_dic_stoichiometry, respiration_o2_dic_stoichiometry, planted_tank_day_night_cycle)

Stoichiometric consistency: respiration_dic (0.01875) = background_bod (0.05) × 12/32; photosynthesis_dic (0.075) = plant_photosynthesis_o2 (0.2) × 12/32. O2↔DIC stoichiometry tests pass within 5% tolerance.
Day-night pH swing test: 48h simulation with 25g plants, zero K_LA, 12h/12h photoperiod produces pH swing >= 0.1 units; end-of-light pH > end-of-dark pH on every cycle.
Heavy plant load (50g) produces larger pH swing than standard (25g), confirming biomass-scaling behavior.
No-plants test: pH swing < 0.02 units (minimal, from microbial respiration only).
Integration test (168h medium_planted): pH stays within [5.5, 8.5] bounds, DIC varies over simulation, plants survive with > 0.5g biomass and health > 0.3.

All closed-system conservation tests (budget_tracking, budget_helpers, microfauna_routing, conservation_regression, feeding_detritus_audit, shrimp_feeding_pathway) pass — DIC rates zeroed in test fixtures that require closed-system carbon balance.
cargo clippy: no warnings. cargo fmt --check: clean.
Pre-existing failure save_load_with_active_cycle_state confirmed to fail identically on master without any of these changes (RNG state divergence through save/load roundtrip).
